panel.title: Stage Controls
panel.description: Holds an expression on top of tracking, adds a floating stage button and a global hotkey, and pings a device on your local network.
status.noHotkey: No global hotkey ({reason}). Use the buttons instead.
status.streamOn: Stream mode on: the floating button is hidden from the capture.
status.missing: This avatar has no {name} expression; it applies to an avatar that has one.
status.blocked: Only localhost, private LAN addresses and *.local are allowed.
modal.title: Stage Controls
modal.text:
This example shows the host-rendered APIs of the SDK.

- The expression blends with tracking: the strongest wins.
- The floating button and the hotkey are released when the extension stops.
- Requests leave from the application, so CORS does not apply.
